data.title: Bitcoin’s Weekly Chart Flips Bullish As 40-Week Trend Turns Higher — Analyst Says ‘Super Cycle’ Is Here
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) is bullish on the weekly chart, according to Wellington-Altus Chief Market Strategist James E. Thorne. He said two major moving averages have turned upwards. He referred to the setup as a “Super Cycle.”Bitcoin’s weekly chart is one of the best-looking setups in the market, Thorne said…
